name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.Leaf.leafKey_real_eq_sim
title: Leaf key: exact simulation with a -G trapdoor (generic ring)
statement: Over a commutative ring, with a gadget Gamma (G dec(y) = y), a gadget trapdoor Tm of B (B Tm = G) and A = B R - G: the leaf-key law (box rejection, preimage of u under [B | A]) with the real trapdoor Tm G^{-1}(A + G) equals the law with the -G trapdoor R, provided the big box covers both shifts. The simulation is exact: no statistical distance.
